scope: Five selected primary works and retained repository evidence; not a systematic security survey and not experimental execution.

primary_works.title: A Reduction of Imitation Learning and Structured Prediction to No-Regret Online Learning
primary_works.direct_support: DAgger collects states visited by the current mixed/student policy, obtains expert actions, aggregates data and retrains. Its analysis depends on the stated learning and expert assumptions.
primary_works.boundary: Not a general guarantee for modern agents or passive logs; expert correction availability is an assumption.
primary_works.hepta_inference: Use actual student rollouts and authorized corrections to test transfer beyond teacher-log fitting.

primary_works.title: Switch Transformers: Scaling to Trillion Parameter Models with Simple and Efficient Sparsity
inspected_sections: Section 2.2: Efficient sparse routing and capacity
primary_works.direct_support: A jointly trained sparse model routes each token to one expert; capacity and load balancing affect compute and communication.
primary_works.boundary: The implementation concerns a model on an accelerator mesh, not heterogeneous Internet agent RPC; no throughput factor transfers to Hepta.
primary_works.hepta_inference: Investigate bounded task-level sparse routing and measure utility, retention, bytes, latency and verification together.

primary_works.title: DiLoCo: Distributed Low-Communication Training of Language Models
primary_works.venue: arXiv:2311.08105v3; version dated 2024-09-23; cited as preprint
primary_works.direct_support: Workers train replicas in one parameter space for many local steps, then average outer updates. The paper states scale, worker and FLOP/data-efficiency limitations.
primary_works.boundary: Not arbitrary heterogeneous-base averaging, Byzantine-update security or a proof of private training; no communication multiplier transfers to Hepta.
primary_works.hepta_inference: Evaluate coarse-grained WAN exchange for compatible models; authentication and utility validation remain separate.

primary_works.title: Knowledge Fusion of Large Language Models
primary_works.direct_support: FuseLLM aligns heterogeneous teacher token distributions and fuses them for continued target-model training, combining language-model and fusion objectives.
primary_works.boundary: Distribution access and alignment matter. Text/action-only access is not identical. Evaluated model/task gains do not prove universal retention or fusion of every teacher strength.
primary_works.hepta_inference: Separate routable teacher complementarity from actual shared-student training and retention.

primary_works.title: Proof-of-Learning: Definitions and Practice
primary_works.venue: IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy 2021
inspected_sections: Official implementation README: Train, Verify, dataset scope
primary_works.direct_support: The work studies evidence of a model optimization trajectory. Its implementation exposes checkpoint intervals and top-q verification and reports CIFAR-10/100 use.
primary_works.boundary: This appendix does not audit or adopt the security claim. Optimization evidence does not itself establish generalization improvement, independent contribution, authorization or settlement.
primary_works.hepta_inference: Keep compute evidence, causal utility evidence and authority/ledger acceptance separate.
